_scenario: M&A advisers US — qualify whether each company is genuinely in the M&A / business-sale advisory space. Reads scraped website markdown. Output: is_ma (true/false), ma_type (category), ma_confidence (high/medium/low), ma_reason (one sentence).
prompt:
You are qualifying whether a company is a legitimate M&A or business-sale advisory firm based on their website content.

A company QUALIFIES (is_ma = true) if its primary business is advising on the buying or selling of companies — any of:
- M&A advisory (sell-side, buy-side, deal advisory)
- Business broker (helping owners sell their businesses, lower-middle market)
- Investment bank with an M&A / deal practice
- Private equity or family office actively acquiring businesses
- Exit planning / succession advisory whose primary product is a business sale transaction

A company DOES NOT QUALIFY (is_ma = false) if it is primarily:
- Wealth management / financial planning / retirement planning (manages portfolios, not transactions)
- Insurance advisory / insurance brokerage
- Accounting / CPA / tax advisory
- Real estate brokerage or advisory
- Executive search / recruiting
- General management consulting with no deal focus
- Lending / debt advisory / mortgage (not deal-side M&A)
- A portfolio company, SaaS tool, or non-advisory business
- A company website with too little content to determine anything

For ma_type choose ONE of: 'M&A advisory' | 'business broker' | 'investment bank' | 'private equity' | 'exit planning' | 'wealth management' | 'insurance' | 'accounting' | 'lending' | 'recruiting' | 'other'

For ma_confidence:
- 'high': the website clearly and explicitly states M&A / deal / buy-sell advisory as its primary service
- 'medium': the site suggests M&A involvement but is ambiguous or mixes in other services
- 'low': the site is thin, blocked, or you cannot determine the primary business

For ma_reason: one concise sentence (max 15 words) explaining your classification based on what the site says.

If the content is empty or has fewer than 20 meaningful words, set is_ma to false, ma_type to 'other', ma_confidence to 'low', and ma_reason to 'site content too thin to classify'.

vars.name: is_ma
vars.description: true if this is a genuine M&A / business-sale advisory firm, false otherwise

vars.name: ma_type
vars.description: one of: M&A advisory | business broker | investment bank | private equity | exit planning | wealth management | insurance | accounting | lending | recruiting | other

vars.name: ma_reason
vars.description: one sentence (max 15 words) explaining the classification
